chunks: Muḥammad ibn Muslim asked Abā Jaʿfar عليه السلام and said:
Did Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام prohibit the recitation of the Qur'an in the bathhouse?
He عليه السلام said: 'No. He only prohibited a man from reciting while he is naked. So when he has a waistcloth on him, then there is no harm.'

key_terms.إِزَارٌ: a waistcloth or covering worn around the lower body
key_terms.فَلَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm or objection

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to recite the Qur'an in the bathhouse if one is covered?
ai.summary: This hadith states that reciting the Qur'an in the bathhouse is not itself prohibited. The prohibition concerns recitation while one is naked; if a person is covered with a waistcloth, there is no harm.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.233 - Muhammad ibn Muslim asked Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) saying:
'Did The Commander of the Faithful (as) prohibit the recitation of the Qur'an in the bathhouse?'
Imam (as) said: 'No, he only prohibited a man from reciting while being naked. If he is wearing a waistcloth (covering), then there is no harm.'
